name: Zoom MCP
tagline: Schedule, join, and summarize Zoom meetings from chat.
shortDescription: The Zoom MCP server. Schedule meetings, list recordings, pull transcripts, generate summaries, and manage participants. The canonical way to give an agent access to your meeting stack.
longDescription:
## What it is

A community-built MCP server for Zoom. Exposes the Zoom API as MCP tools: schedule and update meetings, list recordings, pull transcripts, send invites, and manage participants.

## Why we recommend it

If your team runs on Zoom, this is the cleanest way to make meetings conversational. The agent can schedule a meeting, pull the recording, generate a summary, and share action items.

## When to use it

- Scheduling: agent finds a free time, sends invites, adds the agenda
- Summaries: agent pulls a recording's transcript, writes a summary, lists action items
- Follow-ups: agent drafts a recap email after a meeting
- Search: agent finds meetings that mentioned a topic
installInstructions:
1. Create a Zoom OAuth app at https://marketplace.zoom.us/develop/create
2. Set scopes: `meeting:read`, `meeting:write`, `recording:read`
3. Set `ZOOM_ACCOUNT_ID`, `ZOOM_CLIENT_ID`, `ZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET`
4. `npx -y @zoom/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Zoom: free tier supports 40-min meetings. Pro: $15/month.
